notes:
A much bigger Warehouse, and remote control for your computers. The Warehouse (licence stock) grows into a
full inventory app for the whole team, and NetPilot gains its own remote control in view-only mode.

- Requests and approvals: ask for material (issues and loans) with a reason, approve or deny, hand out and
  return, and open a fault when something comes back damaged. Handing out creates the real stock movements, and loans
  warn before and when they are due. Notifications by bell and e-mail.
- Fine-grained Warehouse permissions and copy access: give each person exactly what they need (view, request,
  add, edit, hand out, approve, count, print labels, import…) on top of their role, including "add but not delete";
  and copy one user's access to another.
- Adding items with a photo: a three-step wizard where the AI Assistant reads a photo and proposes the item's
  details. Each user can set their own AI key in their profile, or the organisation's key is used.
- Check lists for opening and closing, time tracking (clock in and out, your hours, with the legal
  working-time record kept and exportable by managers, every query audited), and club briefs (upload a PDF and
  the AI pulls the agenda by day, with an .ics calendar).
- Generic import of items, categories, suppliers, stock levels and serial units from CSV or JSON, with a preview
  before saving that never duplicates when repeated.
- Mobile home for the Warehouse: big, accessible buttons per person to request, see what they have, scan,
  approve, hand out and clock in.
- Remote control (view-only): watch a computer's screen through its RMM agent, from the endpoint's page, with its
  own permission and activity log.
